title: git-clean: CONTENT_LANDED deletes a branch whose every changed path is byte-identical on main
objective: Close #343: git-clean keeps a branch whose work landed inside a larger squash (a cherry-pick into a work-package PR) because neither ancestry nor patch-id matches. Add CONTENT_LANDED: every path the branch changed since its merge base is byte-identical on origin/main, with LOCKFILE excluded as a regenerated file. Carry the WP-2026-0148 reconcile.
business_value: Removes the one manual cleanup step this repository's own workflow produces -- carrying a reconcile by cherry-pick -- without weakening the rule that unknown work is kept: the comparison is exact per path, a lockfile-only branch is never landed, and a path main has since changed keeps the branch.
in_scope: scripts/badf_gate.py: _content_landed() and the CONTENT_LANDED class in git_clean(); deletable like MERGED/SQUASHED, with the same preserve-then-guarded-delete

tests/test_badf_git_clean.py: ContentLandedTests -- cherry-pick inside a larger squash with a re-signed lockfile, a deletion landed inside a larger commit, a path main changed again, a lockfile-only branch, dry run writes nothing, apply deletes only the landed ones and preserves each tip
skills/badf-git/references/git-cycle.md section 13: the new class and the lockfile exclusion
carry the WP-2026-0148 reconcile, written by `badf_gate.py reconcile WP-2026-0148` (CLOSED, landed_as e2d545a)
out_of_scope: any other regenerated file -- LOCKFILE is the only file `badf_gate.py lock` derives from the others; widening the exclusion is a separate decision
the G07 self-dossier -- assembly is HUMAN_REQUIRED; declared, not worked around
acceptance_criteria: a branch whose every changed path except LOCKFILE is byte-identical (content, mode, deletion) on origin/main is CONTENT_LANDED and PLANNED
a branch that changed only LOCKFILE is UNMERGED; a branch with a path main has since changed is UNMERGED
the dry run writes no ref and no object; --apply preserves each CONTENT_LANDED tip at refs/recovery/<WP>/clean/<branch> and deletes it guarded on the observed SHA
failing-first: the new tests fail against the pre-change gate
ADVERSARIAL: seeded defects -- lockfile compared, branch compared with itself, empty comparison counted as landed, CONTENT_LANDED not deletable -- each turn tests/test_badf_git_clean.py red
evidence: compose output on the PR body

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR; recovery refs created by --apply restore any deleted branch

note: C1: widens what git-clean may delete by one exactly-defined class; the deletion path, preservation and guard are unchanged. The LOCKFILE exclusion follows the existing precedent at badf_gate.py (the surface check that already ignores it) and is the reason the motivating branch qualifies; it is called out for review rather than buried.
